headline: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited announces acquisition; details under regulatory disclosure
sum: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited has made a Regulation 30 disclosure to NSE regarding an acquisition event. The intimation was filed on 19 Aug 2026 but the primary source document does not specify the target, acquirer role, consideration or transaction structure.
implication: Regulation 30 intimation serves as the formal gating disclosure; counsel must immediately obtain the full substance from the company's investor relations page or supplementary BSE/NSE filings to verify deal terms, counterparty, regulatory approvals required (CCI, FIPB, sector-specific), and any conditions precedent before advising on execution risk or structuring.
detail: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited, listed on NSE, has notified the Exchange of an acquisition under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The filing date was 19 Aug 2026. The NSE corporate action archive record confirms the intimation category but the full transaction particulars-including consideration, target entity, deal structure, and timing-are not disclosed in the headline or stub. A full press release or supplementary Form F disclosure is required to establish deal scope, value, and closure timeline.

framework.note: central: Mandatory disclosure of material events including acquisitions within 30 minutes of intimation to stock exchange
central: Threshold-based CCI notification required if combined turnover or asset value breaches limits; deals ≥₹400 cr typically notifiable

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act 1999, s. 6, Schedule I
framework.note: central: If target is foreign entity or FDI inbound, FIPB approval or RBI/DPIIT route may apply depending on sector FDI policy
central: Board/shareholder approval thresholds for asset sale/purchase, amalgamation or scheme of arrangement if applicable

framework.ref: Sector-specific regulations (e.g., Environmental Act 1986, Water Act 1974 if target is waste/water management)
framework.note: conditional: Enviro Infra operates in environmental services; target may trigger sectoral compliance or ministry consent
amended: Preferential issue or issuance of equity as consideration requires prior shareholder approval by special resolution
structural: Treatment of cost of acquisition, merger relief, indexation, and holding period for capital gains depends on deal form (asset/share purchase, merger, slump sale)

framework.ref: RBI ECB Policy (if debt financing cross-border)
framework.note: conditional: External commercial borrowing for consideration requires RBI approval if deal financed by foreign borrowing

conditions: Board and shareholder approval (per MCA threshold)
Regulatory clearances from sector-specific authorities (if environmental/infrastructure licensing required)
approvals: MCA (if scheme of arrangement or asset sale thresholds breached)

triggers.note: Material acquisition triggers 30-minute disclosure obligation; failure to disclose timely risks stock exchange action and director culpability
If combined turnover or asset value ≥threshold, CCI form approval mandatory; deal cannot close until order issued
If consideration or target assets exceed Board limits, special shareholder resolution required; deal void if approvals not obtained
Non-resident or FDI-linked consideration requires RBI/DPIIT approval; breach risks prosecution and repatriation denial
